died recently and for his family and friends saddened by their l oss. throwing open the doors to christ novena this year’s novena continues this sunday at 7pm in st mary’s church, cockhill. for the nine sundays before christmas we will gather for one hour and the ce remony will comprise of the rosary, a talk given by an invited speaker, the novena pray er and petitions (which can be placed in a box at the door of the church), a eucharistic healing ceremony and finis hing with benediction of the most blessed sacrament. once again, the theme of this year’s novena is “throwing open the doors to christ ” – taken from the homily of pope st john paul at the opening mass of his pontificate on 22 october 1978. the guest speaker on the night will be chief superintendent goretti sheridan . all are very welcome. please come along, bring your families and make the most of this opportunity for prayer as we a pproach the season of christ’s birth. “november remember ” pastoral initiative with the grim statistic of there having been 150 people killed on the country’s roads so far this year (12 more than the same period last year) – 45 of these people aged under 25 and 30 aged over 65 (of the 29 pedestrians killed, 10 were over 65) – we need to redouble our efforts as road users to do what we can to make our roads safer, especially as we enter the darker and colder months. to this end, while november is a time when we remember our dead, t his year, in an attempt to acknowledge that the life and death of each of us has its influence o n others, we would like as many people as possible to take on a pledge to use the roads with c are in november. the details of that pledge are to be found on posters and our social media pages. also, this weekend, people are asked to collect a prayer card for their car to be recited each day during the month and a bottle of holy water to be sprinkled on their car and kept there. chief superintendent goretti sheridan will address the cockhill novena on sunday 1 november and launch this initiative. there will be signage placed on the roads entering our two parishes to remind us of this. please do your best to participate in this and support it. father bradley all souls day mass times 9am our lady of lourdes, inch 10am st aengus church, burt 7pm st mura’s church, fahan confessions will take place before all masses. plenary indulgence of
